tasks.name: Asset Plan
tasks.objective: Produce the Asset Plan for this project, meeting every acceptance criterion, then submit it for Studio Director review.
acceptance: Every needed asset class listed as sourced, original or to-be-decided
Licence requirement stated per class (commercial use mandatory)
Reuse candidates named from the existing studio libraries
Budget and timeline per asset class stated

tasks.name: Sourced Asset Records
tasks.objective: Produce the Sourced Asset Records for this project, meeting every acceptance criterion, then submit it for Studio Director review.
acceptance: Every sourced asset has id, creator, source URL, licence and hash
No asset is marked usable without a verified commercial licence
Format and scale compatibility verified by an import test
Attribution list generated for every CC BY asset

tasks.name: Licence Audit
tasks.objective: Produce the Licence Audit for this project, meeting every acceptance criterion, then submit it for Studio Director review.
acceptance: Every shipped asset traced to a record in the catalogue
Zero unverified, non-commercial or share-alike assets in the build
Attribution file included where licences require it
